title: The Hard Thing About Hard Things
author: Ben Horowitz
summary: Ben Horowitz draws on running a tech start-up through the dotcom crash to share frank advice on layoffs, firing friends, and leading when there is no clear right answer.
readIf: you manage or run a company and want honest lessons from the tough moments.
skipIf: you want a neat playbook, as it is mostly personal stories and judgment calls.
